design: An explicit focus break closes the shared time authority and selects automatic capture while suspended. Explicit resume opens focus at the observed resume boundary; an actual lesson interaction may reopen automatic capture. No second time calculator or retrospective segment rewrite.
alternatives: Chosen: suspend capture on explicit focus pause, preserve continued learning through observed interactions
Rejected: keep automatic capture running across a break, which measured 75 seconds for 15 seconds of learning
Rejected: disable automatic effort permanently after timer pause, which would lose actual later learning

defects.cause: Explicit focus pause immediately reopened automaticLesson capture
defects.expected: 10 seconds learning + 60 seconds break + 5 seconds learning = 15 seconds
defects.fix: Suspend shared authority and resume only at observed user action

defects.fix: Controller identity guards at invocation, failure and completion
